investigations.summary: PMM-T1091 expected no 'PMM Server' dashboards folder, which PMM now creates for its built-in alert rules (percona/pmm#5730); main fixed by #1568 after these runs started.
PMM-T1061 on HA opens a pg_stat_database_conflicts row from PMM's own HA PostgreSQL (pgstatements, no plans) instead of the pgsm service; fix keeps the pdpgsql filter.

Compat client 3.9.1: the GitHub runner hosting the MyRocks, Patroni and PS 8.4 setup shut down at 08:53, so PMM-T2079, T2053, T13 and T1790 then ran against disconnected agents; runner loss, not a test or product defect.

PMM-T2227 tarball upgrade hit its 120s test timeout on CLI Generic 3.7.1 and 3.8.0 before the node registered (passing shards take ~25s; it passed in all 4 shards at 00:23); stall inside the test's own install/download, no VM repro run.
The CLI Integration jobs show cancelled, not failed: the Nightly Test Suite run was cancelled at 08:53 with no failed test in them.
